verdicts.reason: A and B are effectively the same broken layout, and the only difference is where a stray thin line fragment sits. In both, the background photo is a crude, blurry, over-cropped enlargement. A stray blue horizontal bar cuts across the image and makes a cross shape with the narrow blue column. The headline wraps word by word ('Win / a / study / grant'), the 'by submitting to' line is broken into fragments, the divider rules are scattered loose, and there are large dead gaps between the text groups, so neither is usable.
